product: Shnuggle Toddler Bath Tub (white, light grey foam backrest)
hand_block: The only person is Grace, and only her hand and wrist are seen, exactly the hand in the hand reference images: medium-brown skin with a warm undertone, medium-length nails with a pink French tip, a glossy sky-blue silicone band ring (the birthstone ring, exactly like the ring packshot) on the ring finger and a thin gold ring with a small stone on the index finger. NO bracelets, NO watch, nothing on the wrist. The hand and wrist enter from a frame edge, no forearm, and the hand stays small next to the tub. When the hand touches something it GRIPS it with curled fingers, never a flat palm lying on it. No face, no other people, no children, no babies.
prod_block: The tub is exactly the Shnuggle Toddler Bath in the product reference photos: one-piece glossy white plastic oval tub, a high curved back that slopes down to a low front lip, a thick rolled rim; inside the back a light-grey oval foam backrest with a tiny embossed 'shnuggle' wordmark at its top; on the outside front a grey oval pebble badge with a white lowercase 'shnuggle' logo; inside floor a smooth raised seat bump and a fine pattern of small grippy dots; a small round white plug in the inside floor near the front. It keeps this exact shape, size, colours and logo in every frame: no morphing, no extra text, no handles, no other parts.

scenes.R1: Setting: a bright bathroom with SAGE-GREEN glossy tiles on every wall and a corner walk-in shower with a clear glass door, chrome shower head, a light grey shower tray floor; the white tub stands out clearly against the green; soft white daylight from a window, clean neutral white balance, bright, no golden, yellow or dark tones; folded white towels, a light grey bath mat. Shot on a phone, realistic, no cinematic grading. No on-screen text.
scenes.R2: Setting: a bright bathroom with soft BLUSH-PINK tiles on every wall, a white claw-foot bathtub with chrome taps and a chrome hand shower, light grey floor tiles, a green eucalyptus plant, a light wood stool with a folded grey towel; the white tub stands out clearly against the pink; soft white daylight, clean neutral white balance, bright, no golden, yellow or dark tones. Shot on a phone, realistic, no cinematic grading. No on-screen text.

video_suffix: Fingers stay anatomically correct (five fingers). The tub never changes shape, size, colour or logo. No sound. No on-screen text.

R1.vo: One year of daily coffee could cost more than this toddler tub.
R1.still: Medium shot at the walk-in shower: the empty Shnuggle tub stands on the shower tray; the hand enters from the bottom right edge gripping a plain white paper takeaway coffee cup with a white lid and a kraft sleeve, NO logo, setting it down on the tiled shower ledge beside the tub.
R1.video: The hand sets the coffee cup down on the ledge, lets go and leaves the frame at the bottom right; the camera slowly pushes in toward the tub.

R1.vo: Honestly though, I get why it seems overpriced.
R1.video: Slow handheld walk-in toward the tub in the shower; only the camera moves, nothing in the room moves.
R1.still: Medium-wide shot of the corner walk-in shower: the empty Shnuggle tub stands alone on the light grey shower tray, sage-green tiles all around.

R1.vo: But when your baby outgrows their baby tub
R1.still: Top-down on the light grey bath mat: a small plain white infant bath tub with a grey mesh newborn sling, no logo, no text, next to the Shnuggle tub, the size difference obvious.
R1.video: Slow overhead drift from the small infant tub across to the bigger Shnuggle tub; only the camera moves.

R1.vo: and the regular tub still feels too big, finding something in between is hard.
R1.still: High angle looking down into a large empty white built-in family bathtub in the same sage-green tiled bathroom, chrome tap, nothing inside it; it looks huge.
R1.video: The camera slowly cranes down and forward over the rim into the big empty bathtub; nothing moves, no people.

R1.vo: Most options I found were for babies up to around six months,
R1.still: Close-up of a small plain white infant tub with a newborn mesh sling, no logo, on the bathroom counter; the hand enters from the right edge and presses two fingertips into the small sling.
R1.video: The fingertips press the mesh sling down gently and lift off, showing how tiny it is; camera static.

R1.vo: and even the ones that grow with your baby typically only go up to twelve months.
R1.still: Medium close-up: a plain grey-and-white convertible infant tub with a fold-down newborn seat, no logo, no text, on the bath mat; the hand grips the folded seat.
R1.video: The hand folds the little newborn seat down flat, then lets go; camera static.

R1.vo: My baby girl is fourteen months, and this Shnuggle tub is designed to be used up to age three.
R1.still: Medium close-up: the Shnuggle tub on the shower tray, half filled with clear water, a plain yellow rubber duck and a grey stacking cup floating.
R1.video: The duck bobs gently on the water while the camera slowly pushes in.

R1.vo: So we're definitely getting our money's worth.
R1.still: The Shnuggle tub on the shower tray filled with clear water and a light layer of white bubbles, the rubber duck floating, a folded white towel on the shower ledge.
R1.video: Slow camera arc to the left around the front of the tub, the bubbles shimmer gently; only the camera moves.

R1.vo: It has a supportive foam backrest,
R1.still: Close-up inside the empty dry Shnuggle tub: the light grey oval foam backrest fills the frame; the hand enters from the bottom right and presses four fingertips into the foam.
R1.video: The fingertips press into the foam backrest, it gives softly, then springs back as the hand lifts away; camera static.

R1.still: Low angle at floor level on the wet white shower tray: the base of the Shnuggle tub with its small grey foot pads on the wet tray; the hand grips the rim at the top edge of frame.
R1.video: The hand pushes the rim sideways; the tub stays planted on the wet tray and does not slide; camera static.

R1.still: Close-up inside the Shnuggle tub with shallow clear water: the small round white plug in the dotted grippy floor; thumb and index finger pinch the plug's little tab.
R1.video: The fingers pull the small white plug up and out; the water starts swirling down through the hole; camera static.

R1.vo: It's sturdy and well-made, so you can potentially save it for your next toddler.
R1.still: The empty, dry Shnuggle tub on the bath mat outside the shower, sage-green tiles behind, a folded white towel beside it.
R1.video: Slow camera orbit half way around the empty tub, showing its thick rim and solid shape; only the camera moves.

R1.vo: But before you buy, check for coupons. If you catch a flash sale, even better, those deals can disappear.
R1.still: Over-the-shoulder-free POV: the hand holds a phone in the lower half of the frame, its screen a soft bright blur with no readable text; the Shnuggle tub sharp on the shower tray in the background.
R1.video: The thumb scrolls the blurred phone screen twice, the tub stays in the background; slight handheld sway.

R1.vo: If you need one anyway, you might as well get it at a discount.
R1.still: Wide shot: the Shnuggle tub on the shower tray with bubbles and the floating duck, a folded white hooded towel on the shower ledge, bright daylight.
R1.video: Slow pull-back from the tub; only the camera moves.

R2.vo: I'm convinced nobody knows this toddler tub exists because it took me almost a month to find it.
R2.still: The Shnuggle tub sits inside the white claw-foot bathtub, completely covered by a draped plain grey bath towel; the hand grips a corner of the towel at the top right edge.
R2.video: The hand pulls the towel off in one smooth move, revealing the white Shnuggle tub inside the big bathtub; camera static then a slight push-in.

R2.vo: I kept finding tubs for infants and babies up to twelve months,
R2.still: Medium shot on the light grey tiled floor beside the claw-foot bath: a small plain pale-grey infant bath tub, no logo, no text; the hand enters from the left gripping its rim.
R2.video: The hand sets the small infant tub down on the floor and pushes it slightly aside; camera static.

R2.vo: but I couldn't find a true toddler-size tub for a one-year-old.
R2.still: Top-down view straight into the large empty white claw-foot bathtub, chrome taps at one end, nothing inside; it looks huge.
R2.video: Slow overhead drift along the length of the empty bathtub; nothing moves.

R2.vo: Then I found this Shnuggle toddler tub,
R2.video: Slow push-in toward the Shnuggle tub inside the claw-foot bathtub; only the camera moves.
R2.still: Medium shot: the empty Shnuggle tub sits inside the white claw-foot bathtub, blush-pink tiles behind, chrome taps at one end.

R2.vo: and it's actually made for ages one to three.
R2.still: Close-up of the Shnuggle tub's front rim inside the claw-foot bath, a small plain teal rubber whale toy sitting on the rim.
R2.video: Slow push-in on the whale toy and rim; only the camera moves.

R2.vo: My baby girl outgrew her baby tub so fast,
R2.still: A light wood shelf against the blush-pink tiles holding a small plain pale-grey infant bath tub, no logo, stored away with folded towels.
R2.video: Slow pan across the shelf to the stored infant tub; only the camera moves.

R2.vo: and she's still too small for the regular bathtub.
R2.still: High wide angle: the small Shnuggle tub sitting inside the big white claw-foot bathtub, showing the size difference, daylight.
R2.video: The camera slowly rises and tilts down over the bathtub; only the camera moves.

R2.vo: I love that this gives her her own space that's actually sized for her.
R2.still: Close-up: warm water runs from the chrome tap of the claw-foot bath, filling the Shnuggle tub sitting inside it, a few bubbles forming.
R2.video: Water keeps filling the Shnuggle tub and bubbles slowly build up; camera static.

R2.vo: And it's made with safety in mind.
R2.still: Close-up inside the Shnuggle tub with warm water and bubbles: the smooth raised seat bump and the grippy dotted floor visible under the clear water.
R2.video: Slow push-in over the water toward the seat bump; only the camera moves.

R2.still: Side angle close-up of the light grey foam backrest inside the empty Shnuggle tub in the claw-foot bath; the hand's thumb rests on the top edge of the backrest.
R2.video: The thumb runs slowly down the soft grey backrest; camera static.

R2.still: Close-up of the base of the Shnuggle tub sitting on the wet white floor of the claw-foot bath, small grey foot pads; the hand grips the rim at the top edge.
R2.video: The hand gives the rim a firm nudge; the tub stays still on the wet bath floor; camera static.

R2.still: Top-down close-up inside the Shnuggle tub with shallow water over the dotted floor; the hand's thumb and index finger pinch the small round white plug.
R2.video: The fingers lift the plug out and the water swirls down the hole; camera static.

R2.vo: If your little one is at or near the toddler stage, this is one of those products I'd save
R2.still: The Shnuggle tub inside the claw-foot bath, empty and dry, a folded white hooded baby towel draped over its rim.
R2.video: Slow sideways slide past the tub and towel; only the camera moves.

R2.vo: because I genuinely wish I had found it sooner.
R2.still: Wide: the bright bathroom, the claw-foot bath with the Shnuggle tub inside and the hooded towel on its rim, eucalyptus plant, daylight.
R2.video: Slow pull-back and slight rise; only the camera moves.

no_hand: There are NO hands, arms or people anywhere in this shot, from the first frame to the last.
